MAXSUN

# MS-eSport B650ITX WIFI ICE

- Model
- MS-eSport B650ITX WIFI ICE

- Motherboard Size
- ITX (170 x 170 mm)

- CPU Socket
- AM5, compatible with Ryzen 7000/8000/9000 series processors TDP: 105-180W

- Chipset
- AMD® B650 high-speed chipset

- Memory
- 2 DIMM DDR5 slots, supporting up to 96GB Dual-channel support Frequency Support: 4800/5200/5600(OC)/6000(OC)/6200(OC)/6400(OC)/6600(OC)/6800(OC)/7000(OC)/7200(OC)/7400(OC)/7600(OC)/7800(OC)/8000(OC) MHz

- Display
- 1 x HDMI 1.4 (up to 4096 x 2160 @ 30Hz) 1 x DisplayPort (up to 4096 x 2160 @ 60Hz)

- Expansion Slot
- 1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 slot

- Audio
- Integrated Realtek ALC897 audio chip

- Network
- Integrated Realtek 8125BG/D LAN chip Onboard Realtek 8852BE WiFi 6 with Bluetooth 5.2 1 x onboard M.2 E-Key PCI-E 2230 slot for WiFi

- Storage
- 2 x M.2 slots (supporting 2242/2280 PCIe 4.0 x4/x2 SSDs) 2 x SATA 3.0 ports

- USB
- Rear I/O: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, 4 x USB 2.0 Internal Headers: 1 x USB 2.0 header (supports 2 ports), 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header (supports 2 ports), 1 x USB Type-C 10G port

- Additional Features
- 1 x 24-PIN ATX power connector RGB Headers: 2 x 5V ARGB headers, 1 x 12V RGB header with MAXSUN Sync support 1 x 8-PIN ATX12V power connector (12V input) Fan Headers: 2 system fan headers, 1 CPU fan header 1 x COM A header 1 x Rear CLR_CMOS button 1 x TPM header

---

A: DP interface 
The highest support 4096x2160@60Hz resolution, can support audio and video output at the 
same time. 
B: HDMI port 
The highest support 4096x2160@30Hz resolution, can support audio and video output at the 
same time. 
C: Double-layer USB2.0 TYPE A interface 
It supports up to USB2.0 standard, and can be backward compatible with USB1.1 standard. Used 
to connect USB TYPE A devices. 

D: CLR_CMOS button One key to clear the motherboard BIOS function Settings, restore the motherboard BIOS default

initialization Settings.

E: Double-layer USB2.0 TYPE A interface 
It supports up to USB2.0 standard, and can be backward compatible with USB1.1 standard. Used 
to connect USB TYPE A devices. 
F: Double-layer USB3.2 GEN1 interface 
It supports up to 5Gb speed transmission, and is compatible with USB1.1 and USB2.0 standards. It 
is used to connect USB TYPE A devices. 

G: RJ45 network cable interface, used for access network cable to connect the host system to the network, the maximum bandwidth of 2500Mbps.

H: WI-FI interface 
The WIFI interface is integrated with the Realtek 8852 WiFi6 wireless network card internally and 
supports Bluetooth 5.2, which requires the correct installation of the corresponding driver for 
normal use.
